title: 足踏みポンプ式の屋外手洗いステーション
description: 屋外イベントや公園作業場所に置く可搬型手洗い設備の静的モデル。成形タンク、実形状のくぼんだ洗面鉢と排水口、曲がり蛇口、独立した二つの石けんディスペンサー、足踏みペダル、運搬握り、背面の点検蓋・給排水キャップを備えます。トイレや飲水器ではなく、水・石けんの内容物は含みません。給排水動作・衛生性能・飲用適合性は検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.714 × 1.201 × 0.772 m、13,748三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A static portable handwash unit for outdoor events and park worksites, with a molded tank, genuinely recessed basin and drain, gooseneck faucet, two separate soap dispensers, foot pedal, carrying grips, rear access hatch and capped service ports. This is not a toilet or drinking fountain; water and soap contents are not included. Pumping, drainage, hygiene performance and potable-water suitability have not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.714 × 1.201 × 0.772 m; 13,748 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
